messages:
marta: Morning — quick release railgate check. Branch candidate built and smoke tests passed on staging. Cherries applied: #3421 (auth token fix), #3450 (metrics tagging). Blocker: flaky e2e on windows-agent failing around kv-cache eviction. Need a backport of the quant-kernel patch to 1.4.x. Planning to promote to canary at 11:30 PT if we clear CI and the backport lands.
kevin: I can take the backport. Will try to finish in ~30m and open PR against release/1.4.x. Ping me if you want pair on merge conflicts.
junaid: can you paste the failing test log here? I’ll triage the race.
marta: sure — failing snippet below:
```
ERROR: test_kv_cache_eviction (tests.integration.test_cache.CacheEvictionTest)
AssertionError: expected 256 entries, got 240
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tests/integration/test_cache.py", line 78, in test_kv_cache_eviction
    self.assertEqual(len(cache.entries), 256)
TimeoutError: process killed after 300s
```
marta: looks like timeout + evictions. Might be unrelated to quant patch but appearing after recent kernels change.
tiago: FYI infra autoscaler saw a memory spike on the staging nodes at 03:12 UTC. Not related to production but could affect longer tests. I've throttled parallel e2e to 4 jobs for now.
devops-bot: :robot_face: Canary window scheduled: 11:30 PT. Will run health checks (latency, errors, p95) for 20m post-promote. Auto-rollback enabled.
sam: :thumbsup: let us know if you want me to hold other trains.
junaid: found a flaky timer in test harness (race where stubbed clock isn't reset). Pushing fix to branch now; will rerun e2e once kevin's backport is merged.
kevin: backport PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4567 — includes quant-kernel patch and changelog. CI started.
marta: thanks — I’ll wait for CI. If green, we'll proceed to canary at 12:00 PT instead of 11:30 to give time for validation. I'll post a final go/no-go.
kevin: noted. ping me if CI flakes, I’ll re-run.
marta: closing loop — biggest risk is the windows e2e; keep monitoring. Anyone else with blockers?
